05 / WHAT MAKES A WINNER

The numbers
decide.

The weekly Top 3 are the three confirmed films with the highest Viral Score. Only the TikTok post you submit and we confirm counts. Bought, bot and fake engagement is removed.

Example: 20,000 views + 1,000 likes + 200 shares = 40,000 points.

Viral numbers lock on 16 Nov 2026 at 23:59:59 UTC. The countdown at the top counts to the film deadline, not to this lock.

If scores tie, more shares ranks first, then more views, then the earlier submission.

VIRAL SCORE = VIEWS + 10 × LIKES + 50 × SHARES
1 view1 point
1 like10 points
1 share50 points
1 comment0 points

06 / GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you
open the door.

Need help?

support@wandura.ai ↗
Who can enter?

Creators aged 18+. Enter solo or in a team of up to 4 with one representative account. Each person may join only one entry per week. Return with a new film each week; consecutive wins are allowed.

How do I receive creation credits?

Apply with your idea for up to 1,000 credits, once per creator or team per week. Approval is required; registration alone grants nothing. The amount and support-credit expiry are confirmed with the grant. Using your own credits gives you the same chance at the prizes.

What if I already have Growth?

Active Growth winners receive 5,000 credits instead of the gifted month, plus their rank’s bonus credits. Prize and replacement credits expire 45 days from each grant, with separate expiry dates. Gifted Growth does not automatically charge you when it ends. Winning films are featured on Wandura AI’s TikTok and website with creator credit. Full prize terms are in the rules.

What must my film include?

A 25-35 second, 9:16 film made with Seedance 2.0 Fast in Cinema Studio, native 720p. Each generation is up to 15 seconds. Edit and export in Wandura AI Edits, with the official Made with Wandura.ai watermark visible throughout. Use fictional characters and AI voices; no real-person images or cloned real voices in this pilot.

What do I submit?

A public TikTok link from your registered account. Enable TikTok’s AI label and include #Wandura #WanduraWeekly #WanduraHorror #AIFilm. Keep the post public through awards. Entries are checked against the Wandura AI export; updates replace the entry and require another review.

Can Wandura AI share my film?

You keep ownership. When you submit, you give Wandura AI a non-exclusive licence, which it may sublicense to its affiliated apps, for 24 months to show and share your film, and short clips from it, on its websites, apps and social accounts to promote the challenge, with credit to your name. Paid ads need your separate permission. Your image, music and audio rights must cover TikTok and Wandura AI’s repost channels; TikTok music availability alone is not enough.
